title: Shopping list and tag filter
prompt:
Extend mealie-pantry (this repository) with a shopping list for the recipes we plan to cook, and a tag filter.

- POST /shopping-list with {"recipes": ["<slug>", ...]} returns 200 {"items": [{"food", "quantity", "unit", "label"}]}: what to buy so that the pantry holds everything these recipes need together, that is what the pantry lacks of their needs summed (a slug listed twice counts twice). A missing or empty list, or an entry that is not a non-empty string, is 400; a recipe Mealie does not know is 404.
- label is the label of the item's food in Mealie: GET {MEALIE_URL}/api/foods?page=<n>&perPage=<n> is paginated like the recipes, with items [{"id", "name", "label": {"name"} or null}], and food names match case-insensitively. It is "Other" when the food is not in that list or has no label. Items are sorted by label with "Other" last, then by food, then by unit, null first.
- GET /recipes/cookable accepts tags=<slug>,<slug>,...: then only recipes that carry every one of those tags are listed.
- Everything that works today keeps working.
